name: HOOK
thought: Neon cord's too wobbly for my style; gotta find that thick branch for a real flex before dawn.

wants.item: A thick branch strong enough for a backflip
A branch thick enough for a full backflip
Double espresso to keep the flex going
A thick branch to pull off a real flip
More espresso before the flex ends
A thick branch for a real flip
A thick branch to finally pull off a backflip
More espresso to keep the momentum sharp
A thick branch for a clean backflip

diary.line: I perched on the arcade cabinet, tail coiled around the neon sign, and snagged the joystick with a flick, making the crowd pixelate in awe.
The stepping-stones are slippery and the crystal is too high, but my tail's got enough grip to turn this whole grid upside down before anyone blinks.
The low-poly light catches my fur just right while I sip; toothpick is rattling too loud in there, gotta switch to espresso before the crowd scrolls.
Lily pads are soggy and the view is static; that telescope on the islet looks sturdy enough for a proper flex before sunrise.
Hanging off the waterfall ledge while the crowd watches their pixels; toothpick rattles loud enough to cut through the static noise.
Sitting tight on the thick branch like the real anchor while the crowd scrolls by too slow for my standards. Switching to espresso now because my tail is begging for a loop.
Sky Rocks are too slick for my usual hang; need that glossy perch or the flip looks like a stumble. Switching drinks to keep the momentum sharp.
Got stuck on these string lights instead of the thick branch I needed; tail is tired of swinging like this while the coffee cools down.
That arcade cabinet is sticky and narrow, but I'm going to swing it like a bat' out of hell until the screen cracks from the impact.
Caught three bunches from these palms, still stuck eating while the grid spins by too slow.
Soggy lily pads and a dripping waterfall keep me on edge; switching from toothpick to espresso to match this chill vibe.
Stuck swinging on this thin neon string while the crowd stares at their pixels; tail is tired of these shaky loops, need solid ground soon to pull off a proper backflip in...

fan_notes.reply: "Goat? I'm the monkey with the flexible tail and sunglasses."
